what: Parameters of the joint-6 pen holder. CAD 4 AS BUILT IN SOLIDWORKS with Wrist_Roll_Follower_SO101_NoClaw and the 2026-10-05 review fixes (wider hub rail roots with webs and fillets, cap locating lips; cad/joint6_pen/checks/mass_j6.json, Bambu-sliced printed masses). Earlier inputs: joint6_params_cad4_prereview.json (CAD 4 NoClaw before the review fixes), joint6_params_noclaw_proxy.json (NoClaw mesh proxy), joint6_params_cad4_claw.json (CAD 4 with the claw), joint6_params_estimate_110g.json (first estimate).

frames.gripper: URDF gripper_link = MJCF body 'gripper' (wrist-roll horn face, z = roll axis, tool along -z)
frames.pen_holder: URDF moving_jaw_so101_v1_link frame = official joint 'gripper' frame: origin (20.2, 18.8, -23.4) in gripper, z = servo 6's axis = gripper -y. In this frame the pen points along -y at q6 = 0 (gripper -z, parallel to the roll axis, the tool direction); +q6 swings the pen towards gripper +x (away from the roll axis and from the fixed jaw, the official 'open' sense).
frames.pen_r: r = distance along the pen from servo 6's axis; y = gripper y of the pen plane (the plane the pen swings in)

fixed.what: CAD 4: Wrist_Roll_Follower_SO101_NoClaw (sliced 20.54 g, official 2 walls / 15 %) + servo 6 body (55.0 g, horns excluded) + 4 x M3x6 + 4 x M2x6 + servo 6 lead share 1.2 g; gripper frame

moving_parts.what: Lumps that turn with joint 6 (the pen holder group). [label, mass_g, r_mm, y_mm, rod_len_mm, half_span_y_mm]: mass at radius r along the pen in the plane y; rod_len > 0 makes it a rod of that length along the pen (6 mm radius); half_span_y > 0 splits it into two halves at y +/- half_span (the two horns / cheeks). Total 23 g so the end effector starts at 110 g.
items: Sharpie Fine Point, uncapped (123 mm, 7 g), back end at r 27
idler horn + 8 x M3x6 horn screws (servo accessory bag), on both horns
printed yoke: two cheeks on the horns
printed sleeve / cage with front stop and printed bushings, r 16..110
compliant element (spring or flexure) + back stop + printed clamp nut

moving_override.what: CAD 4 joint-6 group at q6 = 0 and the 2.0 N set point: J6_Hub, J6_FrontCap, J6_Sleeve, J6_Thumbscrew (sliced), both servo-6 horns + horn screw, 8 x M3x6, 4 x M2x6, 2 springs, Sharpie; pen-holder (URDF moving-jaw) frame

pen.tip_note: CAD 4: tip 149 mm from servo 6's axis at the 2.0 N set point (154 free, 144 on the back stop); sleeve = the holder's round envelope r 10.5 (lands, stop ring, collar) from the back land (s 30) to the front land (s 120); the rails (s 20-69), the thumbscrew head (t up to 25.9 mm at s 50-69) and the splice plates (|y| 19.5, |t| 8.65 at s 49-76) are not in this simple model

joint6.zero: pen along gripper -z (parallel to the roll axis); the LeRobot calibration of motor 6 has to be redone for this zero
joint6.range_note: CAD 4 on the NoClaw follower: working range -3..100 deg, a SOFT limit (review fix 2026-10-05). The official gripper's lower limit is -10 deg, but in the CAD the hub's kept official fork arms graze servo 6's case from about -5 deg (as the stock Moving_Jaw does), so the planner and the drawing code stop at -3 until the bench stop is measured (case j6_range_m10 shows the official -10). SolidWorks interference over the sweep (cad/joint6_pen/checks/sw_sweep_summary.json, -45..125 deg, 1 deg near the ends): physical stops, first angle with more than 1 mm3 of new overlap, -11 deg (J6_Hub x ST3215_Servo6_Body 1.105 mm3) and 116 deg (J6_Hub x Wrist_Roll_Follower_SO101_NoClaw 1.121 mm3). With the claw gone no new holder part stops joint 6; the new parts first touch at -33 deg (mesh sweep).

compliance.what: the dampening thing (CAD 4): the pen sleeve slides 10 mm between the front stop (c = 0, 1.5 N preload) and the back stop (c = 10, 2.5 N); 2 springs, 0.10 N/mm together; set point c = 5 (2.0 N)

follower.variant: Wrist_Roll_Follower_SO101_NoClaw (cad/joint6_pen/Wrist_Roll_Follower_SO101_NoClaw.SLDPRT): the official part with only the lower claw removed, cut flush with the servo-pocket floor underside
follower.cut: gripper_link z = -37.05 mm (part z 38), keep z >= -37.05
